title: TCM-Tongue: A Standardized Tongue Image Dataset with Pathological Annotations for AI-Assisted TCM Diagnosis
reasoning: The paper describes the creation and benchmarking of a tongue image dataset for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) diagnosis. Although TCM is a traditional system with philosophical roots, the paper is a technical computer vision study focused on image acquisition, annotation, and model performance (e.g., YOLO, SSD). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
